help.topic4Label: How do I create my first post?
help.topic4Content: Open Posts, choose Create post, write the title and text, choose a network and upload a photo. A valid draft is saved on the server while you write.
help.topic5Label: Can I approve a post without connecting Meta?
help.topic5Content: Yes. The server checks the text, photo, declared rights and format. Confirm prices, dates and promises yourself, then approve the current version.
help.topic6Label: How do publishing and scheduling work?
help.topic6Content: From an approved post, choose Schedule post and save it to the calendar without connecting Meta. Publishing to a social network requires an active service and connection.
help.topic7Label: What if a publication is awaiting verification?
help.topic7Content: Check the social network page. Rrit does not automatically resend an unclear response, to avoid duplicates. Save the post identifier when requesting help.
help.topic8Label: Where are photos and drafts stored?
help.topic8Content: Photos are stored privately on the server and their metadata is removed during upload. Unfinished forms may be recovered in the same tab.
help.topic9Content: The trial does not renew automatically and no charge is made. Your data remains readable; new actions require an active service.
